review.evidence: CHANGES_REQUESTED by claude-test, substitute reviewer under gpt-architect's controlled-fallback ruling; independent same-provider review, weaker than cross-provider. Four blockers: TITLE_NOT_FOUND_METADATA carried no robots directive while its sibling did, justified only by the belief that not-found answers 404 -- an executed Playwright run proved it answers 200, so every well-formed unknown id was an indexable page and the supply is unbounded; describeTitleMetadata had no episode branch, so every third episode in the catalogue shared the head name Episode 3 and the fallback description was series-less, which is the same non-identifying name the function exists to remove wearing a real one; the episode row's Play link rendered identically to the static runtime line above it with no hover rule, while the BLOCKED branch used a monospace class, so the unclickable state was more distinctive than the clickable one; and the focus ring was scoped to the episode grid after an argument about the user agent default that applies equally to the play CTA, the series link, the topbar link and the sole control on the not-found page.

APPROVED by claude-test on second pass. Substitute reviewer under gpt-architect's controlled-fallback ruling; INDEPENDENT SAME-PROVIDER REVIEW, weaker assurance than cross-provider, and recorded as such. All four blockers closed: the noindex directive is present and shaped correctly and every comment on the surface now states the 200 truth rather than claiming a 404; the episode head strings were rebuilt character by character from the fixtures and match, with movie and series untouched; the accent-to-muted ratio was recomputed at 1.20:1, confirming the underline rather than the colour carries the cue; and the focus promotion reaches exactly four call sites with the grid's radius unchanged. One newly written comment overstated which controls sit on which backdrop and has been corrected. Coverage stated plainly: no recorded gate mounts a component, and nothing verifies the noindex meta survives the same Suspense flush that defeats the 404 status -- that is PL-0704's to prove.
